seo.title: Things to do around Cour-Cheverny | La Vigneronne
seo.description: Discover vineyards, villages, local food and heritage around Cour-Cheverny in the heart of the Loir-et-Cher.

hero.title: There is no need to travel far. Your holiday is all around you.
hero.description: Vineyards, villages, heritage and local food make Cour-Cheverny an invitation to enjoy full days without long drives.
hero.imageCaption: The Loire Valley through the seasons

radius.title: A location that leaves more time for what you enjoy.
radius.text: Use these suggestions for inspiration. Distances are approximate and vary with your route; follow the links for current visitor information.

nearby.title: Cour-Cheverny wines
nearby.text: Visit local estates and the Cheverny wine centre to discover regional wines and the distinctive Romorantin grape.

nearby.title: Estates and gardens
nearby.text: Beauregard, Villesavin and the Sologne countryside offer a gentler day of architecture, woodland and quiet roads.

nearby.title: A day in Blois
nearby.text: Explore old streets, the royal castle, Loire quays and a lively historic centre at your own pace.

nearby.title: Local flavours
nearby.text: Bakery, grocery shop, Friday market, cafés and restaurants make it easy to keep things local.

dayIdea.title: A castle in the morning, local wine, then an afternoon in the garden.
dayIdea.text: Cour-Cheverny makes it easy to alternate major sights, delicious stops and time at home without turning your holiday into a timetable.
